package.name: diy_robot_description
package.description: Robot URDF and static TF tree for DIY Challenge 2026. Defines base_link, lidar_link (Hesai QT64, real measured offset), imu_link (dedicated IMU, real measured offset). camera_link (ZED2i, NOT RealSense) is not yet defined in the active robot.urdf.xacro — see docs/reuse_plan_step1.md for the open item. No gps_link — this robot has no GPS hardware at all. Extrinsic transforms for lidar/imu are real measured values; anything still marked CALIB: in the xacro is still a placeholder.
